items.name: cropper
items.title: Cropper
items.description: An image cropper with the feel of the crop tool in iOS Photos: handles, grid, zoom slider, straighten dial, rotate, flip and aspect ratios.
items.docs: Needs Tailwind CSS v4, React 19 and shadcn/ui components on Radix or Base UI. Docs: https://zriz.dev/docs/shadcn
items.author: pqoqubbw <https://zriz.dev>
